scenes.voice: Your AI agent is just a loop.
The model reads the goal and picks a tool. Your code runs that tool and captures the result.
The result goes back to the model, which decides the next step. It repeats until the goal is done.
scenes.code:
while not done:
  step = model(history)
  out = run(step)
  history.add(out)

scenes.voice: Always cap the loop with a maximum step count and a timeout. Otherwise a confused agent can run forever.
Do you cap your agent loops? Tell me in the comments.
Save this for the next time an agent misbehaves.
